summary: Iteration 12: tested the iteration_11 fixes plus M2 (communications, webhooks, automations), M3 (test drives) and M4 (commission tiers, ledger, exports) on both backend and frontend. New pytest suite: 19/19 pass. Older regression suites: 52/53 pass; the 1 failure is a stale test. UI flows all work: Communication Center, Automations, Test Drives, profile send panel and test-drive request, Sales ledger with CSV/PDF downloads, Partners agreement dialog, and rep RBAC in nav and redirects. Found 2 HIGH business-logic bugs, both reproduced with scripts: (1) reminders still go out for cancelled or rescheduled test drives and appointments, (2) rejecting the sale that triggered a retroactive uplift leaves the uplift adjustment payable. Found 1 MEDIUM RBAC leak: reps can list all automation runs for the org.

critical.issue: A scheduled reminder run never checks the current status of its test drive or appointment. Reproduced: confirm a test drive (a reminder is scheduled), cancel it, move run_at into the past, then call process. The run ends 'success' and sends test_drive_reminder by email and SMS for a cancelled test drive. Reschedule has the same problem: the old reminder stays scheduled and a new one is added when the drive is confirmed again (entity_id includes the time). Appointment cancel and decline also do not cancel reminders.

With retroactive tiers, sale #2 creates an 'adjustment' transaction (sale_id = sale #1, triggered_by_sale_id = sale #2). Rejecting sale #2 cancels only transactions where sale_id = sale #2, so the +150 adjustment stays 'payable'. Reproduced: the ledger shows 100 + 150 payable with only 1 valid sale, so the dealer is overpaid. reject_sale also accepts already-verified sales without any status guard.

minor.issue: Not role-scoped. A rep sees every automation run in the org (54 rows), including lead ids and staff emails in the action strings. Opening /app/automations by URL as a rep renders the page read-only.
volume_tiers counting ignores effective_date, so sales verified earlier in the period under an older agreement count toward the new tiers.

Status is set to verified before commission is computed, and there is no atomic guard. Two concurrent verify calls could both compute retroactive adjustments and create duplicate adjustments; only the 'sale' transaction is idempotent.
Runs 2-3 sequential DB queries per lead for up to 5000 leads, inside a synchronous manager request (POST /automations/process). It will slow down as the data grows.

ui_bugs.issue: Toast text is built from the action key, so it reads 'Test drive confirm', 'Test drive complete' or 'Test drive no show' instead of past tense.

design_issues.screen: Test Drives filters, Commission ledger filters, Agreement effective date, New test drive time, profile follow-up
issues: Uses the browser's native date and datetime-local pickers (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn Calendar or Popover
The Method select text is cut off ('Incremental — each sale paid at the tier re…')
Volume-tier groups still show '$ $0' (legacy referral_amount) instead of a tier summary
The Commission column hides retroactive adjustments (sale #1 shows $100 while the ledger shows an extra $150), which can mislead users

action_items: Before sending a reminder run, re-check the test drive or appointment status (and time) and skip it (status 'skipped') if the entity is cancelled, declined, no_show or completed, or the time changed. Also cancel scheduled reminder runs when an entity is cancelled, rescheduled or declined.
In reject_sale, also cancel adjustment transactions where triggered_by_sale_id = sale_id, and add a status guard (or define the rules for rejecting a verified sale).
Scope GET /api/automations/runs (and optionally rules) to MANAGE roles, or filter runs to the rep's own leads. Redirect reps away from /app/automations, as is already done for /app/users.
Optional: replace native date inputs with the shadcn Calendar, fix the TD toast wording, and widen the agreement Method select.

Update the stale test tests/test_partners_inventory_referrals.py::test_auto_create_via_run_inventory_match_and_patch (referrals are now created on consent, not on match). Note that this test also recomputes inventory_matches on real seeded leads.
critical_code_review_comments: send_communication's idempotency check ignores not_configured and failed rows, so retrying a run's sends after credentials are added will resend (intended). With providers configured, the automation customer_send key is run_id-based, which is fine.
comms._apply_status lets 'bounced' or 'failed' override 'delivered' (intended), and the out-of-order guard is correct.
server.py is still 1721 lines (over 700) and should be split further.
list_comms rep filter: when lead_id is given and is not the rep's lead, it correctly returns empty.

success_rate.backend: 95% (19/19 new tests pass; 2 HIGH logic bugs found by targeted repro scripts)

seed_data_creation: Only TEST_ data was created (leads, sellers, dealer groups 'TEST_I12 *' and 'TEST_UI Agreement', users test_i12_*, sales and transactions); all of it was deleted by id. The automation rules inactive_customer (delay changed 5 then back to 0) and appointment_confirmation (channels re-saved as email+sms, the default) were edited during the test and left at their default values. The stale legacy test test_partners_inventory_referrals recomputed inventory_matches on existing seeded leads when it ran.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the new suite with: pytest tests/test_m2_m3_m4_comms_testdrives_commissions.py -p no:xdist -o addopts=''. It creates leads via the public conversation API and cleans up by id. Repro scripts are /tmp/reminder_check.py (cancelled test drive reminder still sent) and /tmp/reject_check.py (adjustment left payable after reject); re-run them after the fixes. Save buttons on automation rule cards appear only after a field is edited. The profile assign dropdown fills in asynchronously (wait about 2s). Communication permissions are edited in the profile Communications tab (perm-*, perm-save-btn); the Consent tab is read-only.
rca of the issue: Reminder bug: _schedule_reminder inserts an independent automation_run (kind=reminder). _execute(kind=reminder) only loads the lead and sends, and the test drive and appointment cancel, decline and reschedule handlers never touch automation_runs. Adjustment bug: verify_sale writes adjustments under the peer's sale_id, while reject_sale cancels by sale_id only.
